Name: Updated Instant Eat Key
Author: apomorph
Description:
I loved the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4464]Instant Eat Key[/url]. I rebuilt the mod to work in SDV 1.5. My version of the mod is much simpler, and currently non-configurable (this might change; I've just started learning C#).

In game: Hold LeftControl + RMouse to eat a currently held object without triggering the confirmation dialogue. Confirmation dialogue is still in place with regular RMouse click, so you won't accidentally eat items.

Manifest.Name: updatedInstantEatKey
Manifest.Description: Updates nini700's' Instant Eat Key for SDV 1.5.6
